meta.name: apollo-common-errors
meta.description:
Diagnose and fix common Apollo.io API errors.
Use when encountering Apollo API errors, debugging integration issues,
or troubleshooting failed requests.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo error", "apollo api error",
"debug apollo", "apollo 401", "apollo 429", "apollo troubleshoot".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在接入Apollo时经常遇到接口错误
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix Apollo API errors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run into Apollo API errors during integration

howto.what: 装上后，当遇到 Apollo API 报错时，Claude 会判断错误类型（如 401、429、500），并给出对应的修复建议，比如检查 API 密钥、减少请求频率或稍后重试，同时附上官方的文档和状态页链接。
howto.when: 当你提到“apollo error”、“apollo 401”等关键词，或正在调试 Apollo 集成、排查失败请求时触发。

say.text: Apollo 返回 401 错误，怎么解决？
say.note: Claude 会提示检查 API key 是否设置正确。

say.text: 我在调试 Apollo 集成，遇到 429 限流，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议降低请求频率并采用指数退避。

say.text: 帮我看看 Apollo 请求失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会按错误类型给出排查步骤和资源链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Apollo.io API errors are mentioned, Claude identifies the error type (401, 429, 500 etc.) and provides corresponding fix steps, such as verifying API keys, reducing request rate, or retrying. It also cites official docs and status page.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Apollo API errors, debug integration issues, or troubleshoot failed requests, or use trigger phrases like 'apollo error', 'apollo 401'.

say_en.text: Apollo returns 401 error, how do I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest checking if the API key is set correctly.

say_en.text: I'm debugging Apollo integration and hit 429 rate limiting, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend reducing request frequency and exponential backoff.

say_en.text: Help me find why Apollo requests are failing.
